title: My Three Sons Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Incredible porches up and down length of home; outdoor dining and lounge area. Large, fenced yard, two generous porches, & two king bedrooms with ensuite baths! Sleeps 10, great location, "My Three Sons"!
description_expanded: Description665 Forest Street2 KINGS, 2 BUNK BEDS, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA (sleeps 10)Your Seaside Escape Starts Here | Prime Location + Room for EveryoneWelcome to My Three Sons, a classic Seaside retreat tucked along sought-after Forest Street—where everything you come to Seaside for is just a short stroll away. Walk to the West Side Pool, West Ruskin Pavilion beach access, the Seaside Amphitheater, and Airstream Row in minutes. With over 40 shops and restaurants within easy reach, you can park the car and truly settle into the effortless rhythm of Seaside living.Outdoor Living That Sets This Home ApartThis home shines where it matters most—outdoor space designed for gathering, relaxing, and making memories. Start your day on the welcoming front porch, complete with Adirondack seating overlooking the white picket–fenced yard. Upstairs, a full-length porch offers a peaceful treetop setting—perfect for morning coffee or sunset unwinding. Just off the kitchen, the screened-in porch invites long, casual dinners with seating for six and a built-in bar area. Step out onto the adjoining open-air deck, where lounge seating and a swing create the perfect spot for evening cocktails, family games, or simply slowing down after a beach day.Space & Privacy for Families and GroupsThe first floor is thoughtfully designed with three private bedrooms—each with its own bathroom, making it ideal for multiple families or generations traveling together.A spacious king primary suite features a renovated bath with a glass walk-in showerA second king guest suite offers updated finishes and a private ensuiteA bunk room sleeping four is perfect for kids, with direct access to the front porchEveryone has their own space—while still feeling connected.Bright, Open Living UpstairsThe second floor is the heart of the home, where vaulted ceilings and natural light create an inviting space to gather.The open-concept layout connects the living room, dining area, and renovated kitchen—perfect for shared meals and easy conversation. French doors open wide to the second-floor porch, blending indoor comfort with outdoor living.Comfortable living area with queen sleeper sofaDining for eight, plus additional outdoor seatingUpdated kitchen with stainless appliances and new countertopsConvenient half bathEasy, Comfortable Seaside LivingAfter a day on the beach, rinse off in the outdoor shower, fire up the grill, or relax in the private fenced courtyard. With a full-size washer and dryer and thoughtful touches throughout, everything is designed to make your stay seamless.* 5-night minimum Spring & Spring Break, and Summer. 3-night minimum Fall, and 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,680 square feetPrime Seaside Location: 3-minute walk, 352 yards to beach accessPrivate Seaside Residential Beach: West Ruskin Pavilion with access to the largest private residential beach on 30AParking: Designated parking located directly in front of the homeHigh-Speed WiFi: Enhanced WiFi throughout the home with Eero extenders in place and over 500 MB speedOutdoor Amenities: Charcoal grill and enclosed outdoor showerPeacock Alley Linens: Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeResort-Style Amenities Access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote: Includes 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Service: Thoughtful service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & Golf Cart Policy: 2 parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001936
